package.title: NEC Adoption United States
package.shortDescription: A state-by-state overview of National Electrical Code adoption across the United States.
package.longDescription: This package provides a state-by-state overview of the National Electrical Code editions in effect across the United States. It includes effective dates and state-specific amendments. It also identifies jurisdictions where code adoption is handled locally rather than statewide. Links to the state government agencies responsible for implementing the code provide access to additional guidance and requirements.
